column1: # Proposals a human declined, so later audits stay quiet about them.
# Columns: name, code, tag, action, baseline image hash at the time, justification.
# Read the name; the code beside it is what the script applies to, and a row whose
# name and code disagree is refused. To see a flag: https://flagfilter.com/?q=<name>
# The hash expires the rejection: when flagcdn changes the flag, the question
# was answered about a different picture and may be asked again. Delete a line
# to reopen a question early. See #174.

column6: The motto sits on a banderole under the shield.
The green band at the hoist is vertical, crossing the two horizontals.
The red band down the centre is vertical, crossing the four horizontals.
The red band at the hoist is vertical, crossing the two horizontals.
The country name sits on a scroll below the eagle.
The triangle sits inside a lettered ring.
The canton is the Union Jack, a flag within the flag.
Water runs beneath the cactus, the same feature tagged waves on es.
The sun's body is a large round disc; the rays are worked into its edge rather than drawn outside it.
The arms sit on a shield inside an ornate gold frame.
The upper field reads as saffron; it is tagged orange, and both are defensible.
The latte stone is a carved monument rather than a building.
A tilted helmet sits above the shield as the crest.
The sun is a small faced disc high on the oval shield; round, but barely a design element of its own.
Six small yellow stars stand above the arms; whether they stand out enough under the colour rule.
